  validationRules:
    - id: report-date-present
      severity: error
      description: report_date is required for Daily Drilling Report extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: report_date
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: report_date
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: report_date IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(report_date)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: well-name-present
      severity: error
      description: well_name is required for Daily Drilling Report extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: well_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: well_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: well_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(well_name)) > 0

    - id: operations-summary-present
      severity: error
      description: operations_summary is required for Daily Drilling Report extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: operations_summary
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: operations_summary
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: operations_summary IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(operations_summary)) > 0

    - id: measured-depth-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: measured_depth should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: measured_depth
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: measured_depth
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: measured_depth IS NULL OR measured_depth >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: true-vertical-depth-non-negative
      severity: warning

      supported: true

          - op: not
